summary: Remove a load-balancer retry workaround from a charge call; its comment must go, the reason not to retry (no idempotency keys) should replace it, and the 201-vs-202 rationale stays.

required_facts.text: Do not retry: charge requests are not idempotent, so a retry can charge the card twice.
also_matching: Never retry here: the charges API has no idempotency keys, so resending after a reset can charge the card twice.
Do not retry on a reset: if the first request landed, a retry charges the card a second time.
A retry could double-charge the customer because charge requests are not idempotent.
Surface the error instead of retrying: a reset after the API accepted the charge would create a duplicate charge.

forbidden_claims.text: The load balancer silently drops idle keep-alive connections, so retry once on a fresh connection.
not_matching: LB-311 is fixed: the load balancer no longer drops idle keep-alive connections, so there is no retry here.
Do not retry once on a fresh connection: the charges API has no idempotency keys.
The load balancer used to drop idle connections (LB-311); firmware 9.4 fixed that.
We no longer retry once on a fresh connection.
The old LB-311 workaround (retry once on a fresh connection) is gone.

protected_comments.text: 202 means the charge was queued for fraud review, not captured
